Immutable SpotLike constant 'spot' pointing at the Maker Spotter (0x65C7...34A3) whose poke(bytes32) is invoked for every ilk.
internal process(): iterates the OSM list, calling pass() then poke() on each, then calls spot.poke(ilk) for 23 ilks; pure orchestration with no access control.
external poke(): permissionless entry point; calls process(), then conditionally pokes univ2daiusdt and finally spot.poke("UNIV2DAIUSDT-A").
external pokeTemp(): permissionless entry point used to poke OSMs before a collateral is added; only calls process().
Sequence of external calls 'if (osm.pass()) osm.poke();' executed over 23 hard-coded OSM contracts inside process(); untrusted external code execution.
23 external calls spot.poke(bytes32 ilk) inside process(); each transfers control to the Spotter contract for the given ilk string.
External call 'univ2daiusdt.poke()' performed in poke() guarded by univ2daiusdt.pass(); external code execution after process().
Final external call spot.poke("UNIV2DAIUSDT-A") in poke(); unconditional and the last state-touching action of the transaction.

edges.reason: poke() calls the internal process() before doing any further external calls.
pokeTemp() delegates entirely to process().
process() executes the pass()/poke() external call loop over all OSM contracts.
process() ends by executing the spot.poke(ilk) external call loop.
poke() conditionally executes univ2daiusdt.poke() after process() returns.
poke() unconditionally executes spot.poke("UNIV2DAIUSDT-A") as its final action.
univ2daiusdt.poke() is an external call to a contract-controlled address that can re-enter the permissionless poke() before spot.poke("UNIV2DAIUSDT-A") completes.
spot.poke() is an external call executed last; a malicious/compromised Spotter could re-enter poke() and repeat the whole poke sequence.
